name: What types of bathroom faucets are available?

mainEntity.name: What types of bathroom faucets are available?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common types of bathroom faucets include single-handle faucets, which control both hot and cold water with one lever; widespread faucets, featuring separate handles for hot and cold water and a spout; centerset faucets, where the spout and handles are combined on a single base; and wall-mounted faucets, which offer a clean countertop look but require specific plumbing within the wall. There are also touchless options for added convenience.
acceptedAnswer.description: Available bathroom faucet types include single-handle, widespread, centerset, wall-mounted, and touchless options.
